jurisdictions.name: Cloverdale
jurisdictions.notes: Directory lists Building Department phone 707-894-1725, alternate 707-894-1701, counter hours Mon-Thu 1-2 pm. source_url returns 405 to a HEAD request but 200 to GET (directory.aspx?did=31 redirects to it). Portal is OpenGov; building permit category at https://cloverdaleca.portal.opengov.com/categories/1076. adu_page_url is the Housing page, which has an 'Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs)' section; the Building page also links an ADU submittal checklist PDF.

jurisdictions.name: Cotati
jurisdictions.notes: Phone is the Community Development contact on the Building page; inspections 707-665-3632. Email permits@cotaticity.gov. Portal is Cloudpermit.

jurisdictions.name: Healdsburg
jurisdictions.notes: Building page gives 707-431-3346 for the Building Division (fees, inspection scheduling); the page's contact block lists the Planning & Building Department at (707) 431-3348. Portal is Civic Access (Tyler EnerGov).

jurisdictions.name: Petaluma
jurisdictions.notes: cityofpetaluma.org served robots.txt (no relevant disallows) but every page, including https://cityofpetaluma.org/departments/building/, returned HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch on 2026-09-30 (bot protection). No values recorded. Collect by hand in a browser.

jurisdictions.name: Rohnert Park
jurisdictions.notes: Building Division, 130 Avram Avenue 2nd Floor; Building@rpcity.org. Portal is eTRAKiT (permit intake and inspection requests). Pre-approved ADU program page: https://www.rpcity.ca.gov/219/Pre-Approved-ADU-Program.

jurisdictions.name: Santa Rosa
jurisdictions.notes: The city links the Accela portal as https://aca-prod.accela.com/SANTAROSA, which redirects to the recorded login URL; the shorter link may be more stable. Automated inspection line 707-543-3006 (text 'MENU' to 833-692-5526). Building Division, 100 Santa Rosa Avenue, Room 3.

jurisdictions.name: Sebastopol
jurisdictions.notes: Building & Safety, 7120 Bodega Avenue; building@cityofsebastopol.gov. Portal is SmartGov ('e-permitting Public Portal' on https://www.cityofsebastopol.gov/city-services/permits/). adu_page_url is the ADU tab of the Housing & Homelessness page. The Planning page's 'ADU Information' link goes to Permit Sonoma's county ADU page instead.

jurisdictions.name: Sonoma
jurisdictions.notes: (707) 938-3681 is listed on the Building page and is also the City Hall main number in the site footer. Building@sonomacity.org. Portal is OpenGov (viewpointcloud). Not the same as unincorporated Sonoma County; see slug sonoma-county.

jurisdictions.name: Windsor
jurisdictions.notes: buildingpermits@townofwindsor.ca.gov; counter hours Mon-Thu 8-11 a.m. or by appointment. Portal is eTRAKiT; inspections can be requested by text at 877-813-1904.

jurisdictions.name: Sonoma County (unincorporated)
jurisdictions.notes: Permit Sonoma issues building permits for unincorporated Sonoma County; 2550 Ventura Avenue, Santa Rosa. (707) 565-1900 is the Permit Sonoma operator line; the Building Division page lists Building Inspection (707) 565-1679 and Building Plan Check (707) 565-2095. parcel_lookup_url is the Zoning and Parcel Report, which the Permit Tools page (https://permitsonoma.org/permitservices/permittools) describes as: 'Find out your Zoning and Land Use, if your property is within county or city jurisdiction, etc.' Permits Online (Accela) is linked from the same page as https://aca-prod.accela.com/SONOMACO/.
